description: Start a Doctor consult from its quote, then call with its jobId and structured fact, public subject names, league, date, timezone and optional eventId. If the fields do not match a planned lookup, the lookup_not_planned error includes extra.plannedLookups: the exact allowed {fact, subject, league, date, timezone, eventId} fields. Retry with one of those entries and the same jobId. If the plan is not ready yet, retry after the consult has planned it. Returns the outcome, reason and linked sources after the consult succeeds. Use the quoted sources for facts and numbers.
name: look_up_fact
title: Look up a Doctor fact
